messages:
alex.k: Quick idea — can we burst retargeting for the webinar audience and do a creative refresh for search at the same time? Thinking 10 days, reallocate ~20% of search budget into a retargeting-only line item. Current search CPL is ~125 and our retarget CPL (site visitors + registrants) is ~40, so should drop blended CPL. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria.t: Sounds reasonable. Do we have audience sizes for the webinar viewers vs registrants? pace constraints?
jamal: Webinar viewers (>=50% watch) ~6.2k in the last 30 days, registrants who didn't attend ~3.8k. Combined ~10k. Good for a short retarget burst.
sophie: For pacing, let's cap frequency to 3 impressions/day and set a 7-day lookback for viewers, 14-day for registrants. Otherwise we'll burn quickly. Also recommend turning on view-through conversions for the retarget window.
alex.k: Nice — numbers help. Creative plan: 2 new headlines (product benefit + cost saving), test CTA variations (Try, Book demo, See latency numbers). Also refresh thumbnails/images for the carousel — use screenshots with latency/cost bullets. Jamal can you load 3 image variants?
jamal: Yep, I'll upload 3 image variants to the creative folder by EOD. Also will create a teaser short video (6s) for viewers who watched >75%.
maria.t: Budget specifics — shifting 20% of Search (US + CA) means ~ $2.4k/day moving into retargeting line. Proposed retargeting bid strategy: target CPA $45, maximize conversions with bid cap. Does that match expectations?
sophie: That bid cap sounds good. Add automated rule: if ROI < target after 48h, scale back 30% and pause lowest-performing creative. Also set a weekday/weekend separate pace (lower bids on weekends).
adbot: Daily spend & performance update will post to this thread at 09:00 PT starting tomorrow.
alex.k: Landing pages — we should send webinar viewers to a variant that highlights on-demand clips + clear next step (book demo). Plan A: existing webinar LP + demo CTA. Plan B: condensed single-column LP with testimonial snippet and pricing note. Let's A/B for the retarget group.
maria.t: I'll configure the retargeting audience and attach the UTM params. Example UTM: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=retarget&utm_campaign=webinar_q4_refresh
jamal: Creative checklist posted in folder (link): https://drive.redwood/web/marketing/q4-retarget-refresh — includes assets and naming conventions.
sophie: Quick note on search creative refresh — don't change top-performing exact-match headlines. Instead add two new ad groups for expanded match queries and run the new headlines there. That keeps our baseline stable.
alex.k: Good call. Also want to run a small experiment for messaging: copy A emphasizes cost ("Cut inference cost by 3x"), copy B emphasizes reliability ("Predictable latency at scale"). We'll measure CTR and post-click conversion rate.
maria.t: Timeline: setup today, creatives uploaded by EOD, retarget audience ready tomorrow morning, campaign live tomorrow 11:00 PT, monitor closely for first 48h.
jamal: I'll tag the creatives with sizes and copy variants in the sheet.
sophie: I will add pacing rules and automated alerts in the console: alert if CPL > $90 for search or > $60 for retarget for 6+ hours.
alex.k: Owners: alex.k — final budget move; maria.t — audience & UTM; jamal — creatives & upload; sophie — pacing rules & alerts. We'll sync in 24h. :rocket:
maria.t: Any blockers?
jamal: None from my side.
sophie: All good.
adbot: Reminder: campaign naming conventions enforced — will rename if mismatch.
alex.k: Great. If we see regression after 72h, we rollback to baseline search-only budget and pause retargeting. Otherwise we'll extend to 3 weeks and scale by performance. Thanks team.
